title: Maximizing a Product Subject to a Linear Constraint
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Maximize f(x, y) = xy subject to the constraint x + y = 10.

steps.title: Set Up Lagrange Multiplier Gradients
steps.mathExpression: \nabla f = \langle y, x \rangle, \quad \nabla g = \langle 1, 1 \rangle \implies \langle y, x \rangle = \lambda \langle 1, 1 \rangle
steps.explanation: Compute gradients of objective f and constraint g(x, y) = x + y - 10.

steps.title: Solve for Variables and Multiplier
steps.mathExpression: y = \lambda, \; x = \lambda \implies x = y; \quad x + x = 10 \implies 2x = 10 \implies x = 5, \; y = 5
steps.explanation: Equate x and y and substitute into constraint.
